description: GET /statistics/care-time-overruns with confirmed holiday bookings of the school's own children (#5994): the list of api.statistics.care_time_overruns plus one read of the People Directory that finds the children of all own bookings by date of birth; guests and own bookings come in the one holiday statement. Children with a group add the one batched group-name lookup of the roster decorator; constant, not per booking. TestCareTimeOverrunsQueryBudgetWithOwnHolidayBookings compares one with three booked children.
